parameters.help_en:
The tag keys and tag values. You can specify 1 to 10 key-value pairs.

If you specify multiple tags, the system queries resources that are bound to all the specified tags.

Limits:

A tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
A tag value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
Tag keys and tag values are case-sensitive.
Each tag key on a resource can have only one tag value. If you add a tag that has the same key as an existing tag, the new tag value overwrites the existing tag value
parameters.help_zh:
标签键和标签值，键值对取值范围：1~10。

如果指定多个标签，则会查询同时绑定了该多个标签的资源。

约束如下：

标签键取值范围：1~128个字符。
标签值取值范围：1~128个字符。
区分大小写。
同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

The resource ARN format: `arn:acs:${ProductCode}:${Region}:${Account}:${ResourceType}/${ResourceId}`. The following list describes the fields:

`ProductCode`: the cloud service code. You can obtain the value from the response of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html.
`Region`: the region ID of the resource. You can use an asterisk (*) to indicate the current region.
`Account`: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can use an asterisk (*) to indicate the current Alibaba Cloud account.
`ResourceType`: the resource type. You can obtain the value from the response of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html.
`ResourceId`: the resource ID.

ResourceARN supports the `ProductCode` and `ResourceType` values of Resource Group, ActionTrail, and Resource Management
parameters.help_zh:
资源ARN（Aliyun Resource Name）。

N的取值范围：1~50。

资源ARN的格式：`arn:acs:${ProductCode}:${Region}:${Account}:${ResourceType}/${ResourceId}`。各字段含义如下：

`ProductCode`：云服务code。从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html返回参数中获取。
`Region`：资源所属的地域ID。支持使用星号（*）表示当前地域。
`Account`：资源所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。支持使用星号（*）表示当前登录的阿里云账号（主账号）。
`ResourceType`：资源类型。从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html返回参数中获取。
`ResourceId`：资源ID。

ResourceARN支持传递资源组、操作审计和资源管理的`ProductCode`和`ResourceType`
parameters.name: resource_arn
